verdict.rationale: Stagehand documents running its automation on your own infrastructure. You can launch a local browser (`localBrowser.launch`) or attach over CDP to any Chromium you already run, as an alternative to Browserbase. A local user-data directory persists cookies and storage between runs. Caching is described as server-side, though, and observability, regions and contexts are tied to Browserbase, so not every part of the product is shown to run self-hosted. Missing for 10: an explicit open-source license or self-hosting guide, evidence that caching and observability work without Browserbase, and independent hands-on reports of fully self-hosted deployments.
